page.overview:
Who is Adali?

Adali was a woman who was the wife of Doctor Soylon during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. When Soylon was killed by rakghouls, Soylon's companion Doctor Vernan composed a death notice to send to Adali, who he considered to be a stoic.
